questions.question: Which of the following applications has been introduced by the Government of India under the 'e-Panchayat Mission Mode Project' to facilitate online audits of Panchayat accounts and maintain detailed records of internal and external audits?
Which of the following has NOT been included in the world network of biosphere reserves?
Who was the Chairman of the National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD), as of August 2025?
Where was Asia’s largest and the world’s highest imaging Cherenkov Observatory inaugurated in October 2024?
Who among the following was the 23rd tirthankara of Jainism?
अधिकांश हिंदू _______ में विश्वास रखते हैं, जिसमें सत्व और असत्व दोनों समाविष्ट हैं और यह एकमात्र वास्तविकता - समस्त अस्तित्व का अंतिम कारण, आधार, स्रोत और लक्ष्य है।
What is the main goal of the PM-WANI initiative as of January 2025?
options: To provide affordable and high-speed internet connectivity to rural and remote areas
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (To provide affordable and high-speed internet connectivity to rural and remote areas) है।

questions.question: According to the Census, 2011, which of the following states has the lowest literacy rate in India?
Which type of bank account allows the account holder to withdraw funds without any prior notice?
Secondary growth is absent in monocot roots because:
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (the cambium is absent) है।

questions.question: What does Article 8 of the Indian Constitution clarify, regarding Indian citizenship?
options: Rights of citizenship of certain migrants to Pakistan
Parliament to regulate the right of citizenship by law
Continuance of the rights of citizenship
Rights of citizenship of certain persons of Indian origin residing outside India
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Rights of citizenship of certain persons of Indian origin residing outside India) है।

questions.question: In which of the following years was the Prime Minister’s Secretariat renamed the Prime Minister’s Office?
Differences between individuals of the same species or offspring of the same parents are referred to as:
The Swaraj Party was formed by which among the following leaders?
options: C R Das and Motilal Nehru
C Y Chintamani and C Rajagopalachari
Annie Besant and Lala Lajpat Rai
Feroz Shah Mehta and Sarojini Naidu
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (C R Das and Motilal Nehru) है।

questions.question: Which institution maintains the buffer stocks of wheat and rice in India?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Food Corporation of India) है।

questions.question: Who among the following was the author of the biography of the saint Chaitanya, the propounder of Gaudiya Vaishnavism, titled as Chaitanya Charitamrita?
Which project, started in 1975, has been instrumental in saving crocodiles from extinction in India?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Crocodile Conservation Programme) है।

questions.question: Which Article of the Constitution of India talks about the appointment of Commission and Committee of Parliament on official language?
Who among the following was the architect of Humayun’s tomb?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Mirak Mirza Ghiyath) है।

questions.question: Under Article 165(1) of the Constitution of India, which constitutional body will receive remuneration determined by the Governor?
options: Chairman of State Public Service Commission
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Advocate General of State) है।
